title: Drawer Exchange
description: Swap blocks between a drawer and a pad.

policies.prior: Gripper targets in world coordinates; a phase head separates approach, pull and release.
policies.when: Drawer at its calibrated place; the entry stage is uncertain.

policies.prior: Gripper position as an offset from the red goal pad.
policies.when: Red block grasped; the pad may have moved.

policies.prior: Anchor switches with the phase: world, red block, pad, gripper, blue block.
policies.when: The phase is clear; red, the pad or blue may have moved.

policies.prior: Progress along the straight line from the blue block to its slot, plus a small offset.
policies.when: Drawer open; the blue block may have moved.

policies.prior: Gripper position as an offset from the blue slot inside the drawer.
policies.when: Blue block carried; alignment with the drawer slot is the risk.

title: Buffer Exchange
description: Swap two blocks through a buffer.

policies.prior: Offsets from the gripper pose at each chunk start; a phase head separates grasp, carry and release.
policies.when: The arm starts away from home, or mid-skill.

policies.prior: Small moves from the gripper's current pose.
policies.when: Early or late handoff; small gripper offset.

policies.prior: Small moves from the gripper's current pose.
policies.when: Handoff from blue placement; small tracking offset.

policies.prior: Anchor by phase: the blue block, then the red block, then the red pad.
policies.when: Blue is placed; the red block may have moved.

title: Retrieve and Store
description: Store a tunnel block in a drawer.

policies.prior: Small moves from the gripper's current pose.
policies.when: Partial progress or a small arm offset.

policies.prior: Small moves from the gripper's current pose.
policies.when: Block still in the tunnel; the arm starts off-nominal.

policies.prior: Gripper pose in the drawer's placement frame, tracked live.
policies.when: Drawer open; the placement goal may have moved.

policies.prior: Small moves from the gripper's current pose.
policies.when: Release height or closing progress varies.

policies.prior: Gripper targets in the lid's hinge frame; open and close as a learned mode.
policies.when: The lid box may have moved or rotated.

policies.prior: World coordinates with phase cues from the lid, the peg height and the fingers.
policies.when: Default; unclear whether the lid is released or the peg grasped.

policies.prior: Gripper pose in the held peg's frame.
policies.when: Peg held rigidly; peg and gripper moved together.

policies.prior: Gripper pose in the hole frame.
policies.when: The fixture moved; the peg is held.

policies.prior: The peg's pose in the hole frame first, then the gripper through the grasp.
policies.when: The hole moved or the grasp offset changed.

policies.prior: The peg's pose in the hole frame first, then the gripper through the grasp.
policies.when: Peg retained; the hole or the grasp offset changed.

title: Pour and Return
description: Pour into a bowl, return the cup.

policies.prior: Gripper position from the cup, then from the bowl, blended as it lifts.
policies.when: The cup may have moved.

policies.prior: The cup's pose in the bowl frame first, then the gripper; particles as an unordered set.
policies.when: Cup held rigidly; the bowl may have moved.

policies.prior: Gripper pose in the return-pad frame.
policies.when: Cup held upright; the pad may have moved.

title: Store Blue, Keep Red
description: Store blue, keep red inside; the drawer gets reopened.

policies.prior: Gripper targets in world coordinates; a phase head separates approach, pull and release.
policies.when: Drawer at its calibrated place; the entry stage is uncertain.

policies.prior: Anchor switches with the phase: world, red block, pad, gripper, blue block.
policies.when: The phase is clear; red, the pad or blue may have moved.

policies.prior: Gripper position as an offset from the blue slot inside the drawer.
policies.when: Blue block carried; alignment with the drawer slot is the risk.

policies.prior: Gripper targets in the drawer's own frame, sliding with the drawer.
policies.when: The drawer is displaced or already partly open.

policies.prior: Gripper targets in world coordinates; a phase head separates approach, pull and release.
policies.when: Drawer at its calibrated place; the entry stage is uncertain.
